title: A save failure on a page closed while the save ran is reported once per cause and grant
evidence: Root fix R20 (US-09 AC58): packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts saveLoop's catch is silent on a closed device page only for the typed reason writes-stopped (StorageFailureReason, packages/health-core/src/adapter.ts; WritesStoppedError and the session's gate raise it); any other cause reports through reportSaveFailure and shouldReport (packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts). Tests: record-session.device-files-open.test.ts, record-host.save-report.test.ts
